analysis: **The shape.** The SPN AI job scanner reads {sig:student-property-network} ({stage:student-property-network}). Student Property Network makes a free UK app that lists real estate graduate schemes, internships, placements and events for students. Its AI job scanner reads the careers pages of UK real estate firms and adds new roles to the listings as they open; on the day we read the site it listed 175 open roles. The founders, Leo Tashev and Fraser Lloyd, spoke to PrompTugal.news at Night Summit 2026.

**Where the evidence is strongest.** The company's FAQ says the scanner checks the careers pages of UK real estate firms and adds new roles as they open, which keeps its work to one domain's data and carries Contained. Its llms.txt says what the scanner does. PrompTugal.news's interview page reports the founders saying that a large language model decides whether each collected job is accepted onto the list; that describes how it works, and no level rests on it.

**What is not yet evidenced.** Autonomy, Control and Openness show no level. The FAQ says the scanner adds roles itself, but no public page says what role a person plays around it: whether someone reviews what it adds, is consulted on exceptions, or monitors it. No page states a rule that limits it. The pages say what it reads in the same sentence that says what it does, which counts once, not twice. This is a company incorporated in August 2026 with an app first released in October, and each gap is a page away.

**What would move it.** Autonomy 3: a page saying the scanner adds roles on its own and naming when a person is consulted. Control 1: one written rule the scanner follows, such as which pages it reads or what it will not list. Openness 1: a description of the data the scanner uses and keeps, beside the statement of what it is for. Reach 2: a documented connection to a named service.

**Seen, and not counted.** The challenger and the reviewer set aside three credits, listed on the card with reasons. The interview page's summary that the scrapers are the founders' own does not say what the agent is or where its boundaries lie. The About page's feedback channel covers anything wrong on the site and names neither the scanner nor AI output. The FAQ's sentence on what the scanner reads is already counted for what it is for, so it is not counted again as a description of its data.

article.title: Student Property Network's job scanner on the GAMMA-Ray Spectrum: {sig:student-property-network}
article.standfirst: The GAMMA-Ray studio reads the AI job scanner in Student Property Network's app from its public pages: it checks real estate firms' careers pages and adds new roles to the listings as they open.
body: Student Property Network Ltd, incorporated in England in August 2026, makes a free app that lists real estate roles and events for UK students. Its founders, Leo Tashev and Fraser Lloyd, spoke to PrompTugal.news at Night Summit 2026. We read the app's AI job scanner only from public sources, captured and hashed on 11 November 2026, and the published rules computed the card.
**Reach 1, Contained.** The FAQ says the scanner checks the careers pages of UK real estate firms. A documented connection to a named service would reach level 2.

**Autonomy, Control and Openness, not yet evidenced.** A page naming when a person is consulted would reach Autonomy 3; one written rule the scanner follows would reach Control 1; a description of the data it uses and keeps would reach Openness 1.
The card is beta and Student Property Network has not seen it. It can claim the card and add evidence; corrections are dated.

pt.title: O scanner de empregos da Student Property Network no GAMMA-Ray Spectrum: {sig:student-property-network}
pt.standfirst: O estúdio GAMMA-Ray lê o scanner de empregos com IA da aplicação Student Property Network a partir das suas páginas públicas: verifica as páginas de carreiras de empresas imobiliárias e acrescenta as novas vagas às listagens.
body: A Student Property Network Ltd, constituída em Inglaterra em agosto de 2026, faz uma aplicação gratuita com vagas e eventos do setor imobiliário para estudantes no Reino Unido. Os fundadores, Leo Tashev e Fraser Lloyd, falaram com o PrompTugal.news na Night Summit 2026. Lemos apenas fontes públicas, capturadas e com hash a 11 de novembro de 2026.
**Alcance 1.** As perguntas frequentes dizem que o scanner verifica as páginas de carreiras de empresas imobiliárias do Reino Unido.

**Autonomia, Controlo e Abertura, ainda sem evidência.** Uma página a dizer quando uma pessoa é consultada, uma regra escrita e uma descrição dos dados que usa fariam subir cada um. O cartão é beta e a Student Property Network ainda não o viu; pode reclamá-lo e acrescentar evidência. As correções são datadas.

method: A researcher-assessor gathered and captured the sources and mapped the evidence to indicators, without assigning a level. A challenger argued against every level three and four and every doubtful credit.
